The following events took place in '''300 BBY'''.

==Events==
*[[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] is established. {{Circa}}
*The [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] [[Plague on Moltok|begin]] to industrialize and move down from the trees. After disastrous consequences to their health and to the ecosystem of [[Moltok/Legends|Moltok]], they return to the trees.
*[[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]] is discovered and settled. {{Circa}}
*The [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] claims [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="TEA80">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*The [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] lock the [[Spore]] away in an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]].
*The [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] decides to take control of [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] from the [[Barseg]]. {{Circa}}
*Humans discover [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]].
*[[Shaum Hii/Legends|Shaum Hii]] is discovered.
*The [[Nozho–Weogar War/Legends|Nozho–Weogar War]] devastates [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]], leading the native [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] to assume a society devoted to pacifism.<ref name="TEGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>
